title: Incremental Decoding with a KV Cache
learning_objectives: Cache keys and values of past tokens
Compute attention for one new token at a time
Prove the cached result equals full causal attention
entry_point: class KVCache(Wq, Wk, Wv): step(x_t); full_causal_attention(X, Wq, Wk, Wv)
hints: Full: scores `Q @ K.T / sqrt(d)`, mask with `np.tril`, softmax rows, multiply V.
Cache init: `self.K = np.zeros((0, d))`; append with `np.vstack([self.K, k_t])`.
Step: `s = self.K @ q_t / sqrt(d)`; softmax over s; `w @ self.V`.

failure_feedback.advice: Each step must attend over all cached keys including the new one, scaled by sqrt(d).
Start with zero-row arrays of shape (0, d) and append one row per step.
With one cached token the softmax weight is 1, so output = its value.
Mask future keys with np.tril in the full version.
